D: The rebels launch an attack on the second Death Star.
P: Serve the snacks at the Ewok village celebration.
S: for Jabba's cackling sidekick, who'd steal them anyway

Buttermilk-brined chicken thigh nuggets in a garlic paprika crust, fried crisp and tossed in chilli salt, with a herby green mayo for dipping. Cut 700g chicken thighs into bite-size pieces and soak in 300ml buttermilk with 1 tsp salt for 2 hours. Mix 200g plain flour with 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika and pepper. Dredge the chicken and fry at 170C for 5 minutes until crisp and cooked through. Toss in salt mixed with a pinch of chilli flakes. Blitz 120g mayo with a handful of parsley, chives and lemon juice for the dip.
crumbed prawns, because Jabba eats frogs live
Butterflied prawns in flour, egg and panko, fried at 180C for 2 minutes, sweet chilli and lime.
A bowl of mixed berries and cherries tossed with a little honey and mint, with a pot of whipped mascarpone.
M: roast chicken with a honey glaze, Han was almost on the menu
Whole chicken spatchcocked, roasted at 220C for 40 minutes, glazed with honey, garlic and thyme for the last 10. Roast root vegetables.
a big slab of everything, served before the Sarlacc pit

Salt and pepper brisket smoked low until it wobbles, sliced thick with sticky barbecue sauce, tangy slaw, pickles and soft white bread. Rub a 2.5kg brisket with 2 tbsp coarse salt and 2 tbsp cracked pepper. Smoke or roast at 120C for about 10 hours until 95C inside, wrapping in baking paper once it reaches 70C. Rest 1 hour. Shred quarter of a cabbage and 1 carrot and toss with 3 tbsp mayo and 1 tbsp cider vinegar. Slice the brisket thick and serve with barbecue sauce, the slaw, dill pickles and white bread.
W: Bubbling mixed forest berries under a crunchy oat, hazelnut and brown sugar crumble, served warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. Heat the oven to 180C. Toss 750g frozen mixed berries with 80g caster sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour in a baking dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 120g plain flour until crumbly, then stir in 60g rolled oats, 50g chopped hazelnuts and 100g brown sugar. Scatter over the berries and bake 35 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges. Rest 5 minutes and serve warm with vanilla ice cream.
K: Cold milk blended with frozen pineapple, lime and a drop of blue spirulina until smooth.

s.note: crumbed prawns, because Jabba eats frogs live
s.how: Butterfly 500g peeled green prawns. Dip in flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then 100g panko. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes until golden. Drain and serve hot with sweet chilli sauce and lime wedges for squeezing.

Toss 250g strawberries, halved, 125g blueberries and 200g pitted cherries with 1 tbsp honey and torn mint. Whip 250g mascarpone with another spoon of honey until soft. Serve the fruit in a bowl with the mascarpone alongside.

m.note: roast chicken with a honey glaze, Han was almost on the menu
m.how: Spatchcock a 1.8kg chicken and lay over 800g potatoes and 4 carrots cut into chunks. Roast at 220C for 40 minutes. Brush with 3 tbsp honey warmed with 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme for the last 10 minutes. Rest and pull apart to share.

w.how: Heat the oven to 180C. Toss 750g frozen mixed berries with 80g caster sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour in a baking dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 120g plain flour until crumbly, then stir in 60g rolled oats, 50g chopped hazelnuts and 100g brown sugar. Scatter over the berries and bake 35 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges. Rest 5 minutes and serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

d.how: Blend 800ml cold milk with 200g frozen pineapple, the juice of a lime and half a tsp blue spirulina until smooth and pale blue. Pour into four glasses and drink straight away, before the Ewoks get it.
